en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a very crowded seaside beach with men, women, and children in early 20th‑century swimwear. A large wooden beach pavilion or bathhouse stands on the left, with people on its upper deck, while the sandy shore and sea are full of bathers stretching into the distance. Forested hills and cliffs appear in the background. Along the lower border is printed text in Cyrillic and German indicating the location as Varna/Warna and describing the mixed ladies' and gentlemen's beach.
